fee_notes: Royalty is 6% of Net Sales, paid weekly by EFT. National Marketing and Advertising Contribution is currently 2% of Net Sales, but may be increased up to 4% with 60 days' written notice. Local Marketing and Advertising Contribution is currently none but may be required up to 2% of Net Sales with 60 days' notice. Regional Co-op is currently none but may be up to 3% of Net Sales. Maximum total advertising expense is 6% of Net Sales (Note 3 states 6%, while the table states 5% maximum — possible discrepancy). Technology Fee is currently $350/month, subject to annual increase of up to 15% compounded. All fees are nonrefundable and uniformly imposed.
